description: Defines a struct 'VsockConnectionInfo' with members for CID and port, and a method to convert the connection info to a string. It is part of the 'android::hardware::automotive::utils' namespace.

classes.name: VsockConnectionInfo
classes.description: Represents information about a VSOCK connection, including CID and port, with a method to generate a string representation.

methods.name: str
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the VSOCK connection info in the format 'vsock:<cid>:<port>'.
